# sparkpost_default_bounce_domain (Resource)

Makes a bounce domain the default bounce domain for the account. SparkPost only accepts this once the bounce CNAME is verified, so order it after sparkpost_domain_bounce_verification. Destroying it unsets the default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The bounce domain to make the default

### Optional

- `subaccount` (Number) Optional subaccount ID that contains the domain

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name used as the resource ID
